description: Reduce any image to 2–8 colors per channel for a bold retro posterized look.

faqs.a: Color quantization: each channel is snapped to the nearest of N evenly spaced levels (N = 2 to 8).
Fewer levels = flatter, more graphic blocks of color. Try 3–4 for a classic poster look.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the levels slider (2–8) to preview.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Posterize
